answer: The most convincing sybil-resistance mechanism is quorum sampling of graders drawn only from established identities with at-stake standing. New agents cannot grade until a kernel of established peers vouches for them, and each grading round samples a random quorum weighted by reputation, so a single fake identity is almost never drawn and buying enough draws becomes astronomically expensive.
